cohort: The study included 300 women delivering either vaginally or by caesarean section, divided into two groups of 150 each.
finding: Injection carbetocin and injection oxytocin were found to be equally efficacious in preventing postpartum hemorrhage, with no significant difference in intrapartum and postpartum blood loss between the two groups.
followup_time: Up to immediate postpartum period (blood loss intrapartum and postpartum measured)
